provenance.relationship: The inventory catalog identity and strict recovered bundle are independent identities. No byte-equivalence claim is made; the strict recovered deployment defines compatibility.

bindings.DB: isolated PostgreSQL schema cf_shadowglass_v35 with verified transformed import
bindings.DEDUP_KV: scoped PostgreSQL dedup_kv table; shared namespace import fails closed without an owned-key rule
bindings.R2_RECORDS: legacy bucket had no referenced rescued rows; new documents use an isolated MinIO identity and bucket
bindings.SCRAPE_QUEUE: PostgreSQL leased queue with idempotency, retry, lease recovery, and dead-letter state
bindings.RELAY_URL: loopback-only ShadowGlass Master plus exact-origin allowlist; never caller-controlled

instrument_taxonomy.source: exact array embedded in the hash-pinned rescued v35 worker
instrument_taxonomy.neighbor_state_excluded: Three v8-only types are deliberately excluded because they are absent from v35 source.

schedule.legacy_trigger_reconciliation: The locked legacy Cloudflare account is not read or mutated during policy-safe deployment. Local consumer and timer remain disabled, while proof units verify their identities without creating a second producer.

release_gate.identity: clean Git HEAD plus deterministic git-archive source digest
release_gate.staging: release-scoped disposable PostgreSQL database, MinIO bucket, credentials, route smoke, endpoint semantics, consumer canary, and scheduler proof
release_gate.finalization: release-bound evidence digests, exact route audit, D1/KV reconciliation, and installed-unit byte equality

intentional_security_deltas: Only /health is unauthenticated; all data, dashboard, scrape, queue-control, and relay-probe routes require scoped credentials.
The direct scrape route is durable-queue backed instead of bypassing retry and idempotency controls.
The public relay is replaced by loopback-only ShadowGlass Master validation with an exact-origin allowlist.
All imported counties start inactive; only the reviewed provider-compatible subset is reactivated after live verification.
No replacement public hostname is created without explicit routing evidence.
